entries.title: Ezekiel 2:1
segments: ¶And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak with thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:2
segments: And the Spirit entered into me when he spoke unto me, and set me upon my feet; and I heard him that spoke unto me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:3
segments: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to nations that are rebellious, which have rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me unto this very day;

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:4
segments: and these children are impudent and hard-hearted: I am sending thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:5
segments: And they, whether they will hear or whether they will forbear--for they are a rebellious house--yet shall they know that there hath been a prophet among them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:6
segments: ¶And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, and be not afraid of their words; for briars and thorns are with thee, and thou dwellest among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, and be not dismayed at their faces; for they are a rebellious house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:7
segments: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear or whether they will forbear; for they are rebellious.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:8
segments: And thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:9
segments: And I looked, and behold, a hand was put forth toward me; and behold, a roll of a book therein.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:10
segments: And he spread it out before me; and it was written within and without; and there were written in it lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
